title: Normalized finite-root site realization
statement: Let ell be prime and f:X→Y separated, finite-type, compactifiable and smooth of pure dimension d between Noetherian schemes, with ell invertible on Y. At every positive level, the actual comparison image of the double-lift coefficient root line is isomorphic to the pro-etale roots-of-unity sheaf, normalized on every etale root generator and every pro-etale restriction exactly as RootSiteTransport [def-pur-finite-smooth-canonical-maps].

source.place: sk-thm-smooth-purity and proof: inverse diagonal orientation followed by the tensor map; sk-prop-sp-orientation.proof.md: diagonal, deformation, vector bundle; sk-lem-sp-reduction.proof.md and sk-lem-sp-reduction-compatibilities.proof.md: counit-defined coefficient comparisons and quotient cocycle. The ordinary-etale Noetherian formulation retains arbitrary ground fields.

proof.text: The scalar map from Z/(ell^n) to its double lift is the canonical ring equivalence. Scalar extension along this equivalence is an equivalence, so its adjunction unit is invertible. The enhanced ordinary roots presheaf is a sheaf after forgetting coefficients, hence is a module sheaf. Equivalence preserves its sheaf condition, so its sheafification unit is invertible. Their composite is precisely ordinaryFiniteRootMap. Prove the scalar-forgetting site comparison isomorphism directly by commuting forgetting past Kan extension and sheafification, with its adjunction-unit equation. This unit equation identifies the inverse with cartierForgetComparison. Compose inverse scalar coordinates with the canonical Cartier roots isomorphism. Its kernel-lift equation and the adjunction equation for cartierUnitsComparison give the required identity at every etale test. Naturality of the roots isomorphism and inclusion in units gives the identity after every pro-etale restriction. Pullback of the global unit on Y supplies invertibility on X. All categorical helper equations and scalar/sheafification assertions are proved in the delivered module from Mathlib.

proof_origin.place: Proved root realization. All Kan/sheafification and unit equations are proved private helpers; only the existing canonical Cartier roots isomorphism is imported as a theorem. The ordinary compact-support quotient cocycle belongs to the separate quotient-coherence lemma.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteSmoothSiteRealizations
    (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [HasCompactification f] [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated f]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (d : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f]
    (hY : ∀ y : Y, IsUnit (ell : Y.presheaf.stalk y))
    : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n →
      Nonempty (RootSiteTransport ell n X) ∧ Nonempty (RootSiteTransport ell n Y)
